text: Today I'm taking my child to take pictures. When I entered the shop, I asked the staff if they had any stickers, but they responded in a harsh, rude tone. restaurant_name: ClinicKlong Studio (ห้องภาพคลีนิคกล้อง)
text:
Terrible! The service was absolutely awful. I went to the photo studio on June 6th for a dozen 2-inch photos, paying 250 baht. They said the photos would be ready on June 7th at 6:00 PM. On June 7th at 12:00 PM, I called to ask if the photos were ready, and they said they hadn't even started. So I said if they hadn't started, I wanted to change it to half a dozen 2-inch photos and half a dozen 1-inch photos instead. When I went to pick up the photos, I had to pay an extra 120 baht because it was an urgent order. How is it urgent when you said you hadn't started yet?
A dozen 1-inch photos cost 240 baht.
A dozen 2-inch photos cost 250 baht.
Half a dozen 1-inch photos should cost 120 baht.
Half a dozen 2-inch photos should cost 125 baht.
I already paid 250 baht on the first day, so that should have been the full amount. When I called to ask, you said you hadn't started yet. If you had already started and asked for an extra charge, that would be one thing. But you're asking for an extra 120 baht! When I asked about the 250 baht I paid yesterday, you replied that yesterday's orders were for yesterday's items, and that I had to pay more today. But for the 250 baht I paid, I only got half a dozen photos! You two could close your shop and become professional con artists. You're both thieves who want to open a legitimate camera shop!

text:
(I thought it was a professional, ethical salon.)
The outfit and makeup were complete, but the photos turned out terrible. They didn't even do my frizzy hair, and they made my nose look really crooked in the pictures. I don't know if the photos are even usable. They even tried to rip me off with the price, constantly quoting half a dozen/a dozen... I was going to bookmark this as my regular salon, but now I've changed my mind. Terrible.

restaurant_name: ClinicKlong Studio (ห้องภาพคลีนิคกล้อง)
text:
Today (July 22, 2021), I used their photo service again, for the second time.
(The first time was in January 2019.)
I used their service to have 1-inch photos taken, have them edited, and buy the digital files.

1 dozen photos/150 baht, photo editing + 50 baht.
Buying the digital files + 100 baht.
But I only got 1-inch photos back??? Why did they sell me only 1-inch photos?
I can take larger files of my own photos with my phone at home.
They didn't mention that I would only get 1-inch photos when they sold them to me.
They only told me after I paid, and the tone of their voice was really unpleasant.

#I paid for the service, I wasn't asking for it for free, and I wasn't being demanding.

During the service, the shop didn't offer any advice before taking the photos.
For example, crooked ties, collars covering ties, or wrinkled shirts that don't look good, etc. We had to figure it out ourselves.
Anyone who is in a hurry but needs good photos for important use should think carefully before using their service.
I've had photos taken at this shop twice. If you look closely at my photos, you can see flaws in both pictures.

*****************************************

There are two female "service providers" in the shop.
I don't know if you're the owners, but I'll refer to them as "service providers."
One was polite and provided good service, appropriate for a "service provider."
The other was a middle-aged woman, let's call her "Auntie."
Auntie's "words" and "tone of voice" were unpleasant and unsuitable for a "service provider."
I'm a straightforward customer, but after listening to her, I didn't want to continue the conversation.
And I don't think I'll use their services again.
I'd rather go to another shop if the communication and service are like this.
Because this shop isn't anything special.
If you need "quick photos," this shop is average.
Price: 12 photos/150 baht

P.S. I usually use other photo shops, but I came to this one because I was in a hurry and it was on my way.
Other shops offer advice and help with adjusting your outfit, such as collars, ties, sleeves, etc.
But at this shop, customers have to do everything themselves before the photo shoot. There was no notification or suggestion.

************************************
This shop should improve its service.
For example, inform customers about issues like crooked collars, misaligned ties, wrinkled shirts, or provide clearer product descriptions so customers are aware, to prevent problems like mine from occurring.
